title: Death undetermined
article: The B.C. Coroner's Service hasn't determine yet how a man died after being arrested by RCMP last November.
Coroner Maureen Wint said earlier this week that she is still awaiting a final autopsy report on the death of Lyndon Charles Valan.
As with any custody death, the case will be the subject of a coroner's inquest. Valan died after he was arrested at a Sidney residence on Nov. 29, 2003.
RCMP said that Valan appeared to be under the influence of drugs and confronted officers outside the house with a kitchen knife and a large boxcutter.
He dropped the weapons when ordered to by police, but became violent again after he was placed in handcuffs.
